items.difficulty_reason: Compact objects of D_{QCoh,T} are exactly perfect: observes the subcategory is triangulated with direct sums; perfect implies compact via proposition-compact-is-perfect (a fortiori in any direct-sum-preserving subcategory); conversely the perfect generator E from lemma-generator-with-support is compact and a classical generator of the compact objects (Derived Categories proposition), so every compact object is built from E by shifts, finite sums, cones and summands - each preserving perfectness.
